summary: Blue Owl Real Estate Net Lease Trust filed an 8-K for two events. On September 1, 2026, it sold 16,640,734 common shares across four classes (S, N, D, I) for ~$178.6 million gross proceeds at NAV, under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D/S. On August 25, 2026, it declared monthly distributions of $0.0625 per share gross across all classes (net of shareholder servicing fees ranging from $0.0022281 to $0.0076808 per share), payable September 17, 2026 to holders of record August 31, 2026, in cash or via DRIP. This is a routine capital raise and distribution declaration for a perpetual net-lease REIT.
